title: Batch Board
conductorPlaceholder: Message the conductor, e.g. do project X first, stop task Y…
emptyBody: Open the Todos window, press 🤖 "Hand to AI" (or 🤖 on a project folder), pick todos and start. This board then shows every task so you can answer permissions and questions and review the results.
finishTitle: Mark the todo done and delete the worktree (branch kept)
finishUncommitted: The worktree still has {n} uncommitted files, lost when it is deleted. Mark done anyway?
discardMessage: Discard this task's result? The todo goes back to not started.
discardMessageWorktree: Discard the result? The worktree and branch {branch} are deleted (unpushed commits included) and the todo goes back to not started.

start.title: Hand todos to AI
start.hint: A conductor splits the work: one worker per todo, each in its todo's own project (settings, rules, accounts). Follow along and answer permissions on the Batch Board.

isolationHint.rules: Each worker creates its own worktree / branch the way its project’s rules & skills say (e.g. project-docs-structure) before editing — works for any project layout, including a workspace around its repos. Projects without such a convention run one task at a time.
isolationHint.devdy: Devdy creates .devdy/worktrees/<name> from the latest code for each task. Only for project folders that are a git repository root; other projects fall back to "Project rules".
isolationHint.none: Work right in the project folder, one task per project at a time.

discardMessageCommits: Discard the result? Branch {branch} has {n} commits — if they are not pushed they are LOST with the worktree. Use "Push & open PR" first to keep them. The todo goes back to not started.
